description: Evaluates whether the skill produces premium agency-quality visual design

criteria.description: Animations must use spring/cubic-bezier easing, not linear or ease-in-out
Must create visual depth with subtle shadows, layered surfaces, or glassmorphism
Must include hover, focus, active state transitions on interactive elements
Must use intentional whitespace/padding — not cramped, not wasteful
Must use a restrained palette (2-3 accent colors max), not rainbow
Must pair fonts intentionally (heading + body + mono), not use a single generic font
Must NOT use generic AI patterns: oversaturated neon, gradient text headers, 3-col equal grids, stock photos

testPrompt: Design a premium dashboard overview card grid for a fitness training platform. It should show: total workouts, active clients, revenue this month, next session, and a weekly activity sparkline. Dark theme, luxury aesthetic.
